snippet.title: Battle Vision Dev Diary #1 - We're baaack!
snippet.description:
Sign up for the Battle Vision playtest and wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216850/Battle_Vision/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=sm&utm_campaign=wl

Our studio head Dan is here to talk about Battle Vision's development, while our community manager Bianca lets us know what's ahead for the game. We're back and better than ever!

The game is still in development; visuals and concepts are still subject to change.
